about_the_game:
You are BRU, the intrepid underpanted puer aeternus. All you wanted was some milk for your coffee, but ended up incarcerated for a crime you did in fact commit. The indomitable human spirit cannot be denied however, as Bru must now stage an escape from prison to get some sugar for his caffeine fix.

But all of Earth's sugar is mysteriously disappearing, and as you point and click yourself deeper into the seedy under, mid, and top belly of Kifftown, Bru will uncover a conspiracy that goes even deeper than his underpants.

Bru and Boegie : Episode 2 – Get Da Sugar is another colorful, fully animated and fully-voiced adventure, that will test the limits of your Big Brain.

Fortune favours the bald, and now’s your time to shine (your head).

Includes:

  • MAP-O-DESTINY: Travel between loads of new locations including Stacy's Mansion, Mr. Bergie's Box Ranch, Anxiety Village Shopping Mall, Illuminati HQ and more! It’s a big, scary world out there, but at least you have your trusty tricycle.

  • TIME IS AN ILLUSION: More than 5 times the length of the first game! This substantial, fully-featured, and self-contained experience will inch you closer to your end.

  • WE ARE IN CONTROL: Incredibly intuitive one-button-gameplay.

  • THEY’RE ALL LAUGHING AT YOU: Bru's particular brand of irreverent and deadpan satirical humor has been perfectly tuned to appeal to your brain. That’s right, YOU.

  • THEY’RE EVERYWHERE: Explore deeper into Kifftown, and discover an absolute infestation of its weirdo inhabitants.

  • A GAME WITHIN A GAME: Play a host of mini-games to consume you from the inside.

  • THEY’RE HIDING IN PLAIN SIGHT: A host of secret collectables to find and keep you up at night.

  • THE VOICES, THEY’RE GETTING LOUDER!: Fully voiced by actual humans…or are they??? (Ed: Yes, they are.)

All this and more await you in Bru & Boegie: Episode 2 - Get da SUGAR!

Whispers on the wind speak of Episode 3 in development too. Woo eee ooo.

short_description: Break out of prison and hunt down Kifftown’s missing sugar! Uncover a bizarre conspiracy in this massive, fully-animated and voiced 2D point & click comedy that will test your Big Brain. Fortune favors the bald, and now’s your time to shine (your head).
